caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden piano with a reddish-brown finish, supported by four turned legs that are darker in color. The instrument has a keyboard in the center, flanked by decorative latticework and gold-colored detailing above the keys. There is a drawer located beneath the keyboard with a small round knob. On top of the piano, an open sheet music book is propped up on a built-in stand, displaying visible musical notes and staves, with pages that are light in color with faint writing. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or elements. In the bottom right corner, there is a signature that reads “Virginia Kennedy, P.A.P. of Va.”
title: Piano
